dedupe_keys.name: sdes freight transport statistics by mode maritime rail inland waterway france

description: The statistical service of the French ministry in charge of transport (SDES) publishes yearly freight transport data sets by mode on data.gouv.fr. Rail freight gives tonnes and tonne-kilometres by region of origin and destination, product type, packaging and type of transport, from a survey of railway undertakings run by SDES since 2012. Inland waterway freight gives tonnes and tonne-kilometres by region and department of origin and destination, product, packaging, type of transport and flag, from the information system of Voies navigables de France. Maritime freight gives yearly tonnes and container counts in TEU by type of goods per port, from port authority declarations; some ports have data only after 2000, and a file lists the start year per port. Coverage is national. Access: CSV files with HTML documentation, free under the Licence Ouverte (Etalab), updated yearly in 2026. Caveats: some series are withheld for statistical secrecy, and definitions differ between modes. The data support freight network flow and modal split models, port and waterway capacity planning and resilience studies of French supply chains. They complement Eurostat transport statistics and the ART regulator open data catalogued here.
